**Table 1. Variables and data sets**

| Variable / set | Range or size | Sampling / use |
|---|---|---|
| ΔV_in (input) | 100 µV – 300 mV | log-uniform |
| VCM (input) | 0.4 -- 0.6 V | uniform |
| VDD (input) | 0.9 -- 1.1 V | uniform |
| T (input) | 0 – 85 °C | uniform |
| t_d (output) | 36 -- 285 ps | clock 50 % to output VDD/2 |
| E (output) | 23 -- 43 fJ | supply energy per cycle |
| train | 2800 | scrambled Sobol; training |
| val | 600 | uniform random; early stopping, sizing |
| test | 600 | uniform random; final accuracy (used once) |
| extrap | 500 | ΔV_in 1–100 µV, t_d 83–345 ps; used once |
| slices | 306 | 9 conditions × 34 ΔV_in (1 µV – 300 mV); Figs 4, 8 |
| reference curves | 771 | VCM = VDD/2, 9 conditions, 10 fV – VDD; Fig 9 |

**Table 2. Model structures**

|  | ReLU MLP | tanh MLP (control) | KBNN |
|---|---|---|---|
| Layers | 3 | 3 | 4 |
| Inputs | log10|ΔV_in|, VCM, VDD, T | same | VCM, VDD, T; |ΔV_in| → L, v |
| Hidden layer | 50 ReLU | 12 tanh | 2 blocks $\times$ 25 ReLU |
| Linear outputs | t_d, E | t_d, E | t0, τ, E0, s; g, q |
| Knowledge layer | -- | -- | t_d = t0 + τL + [g(v) − g(0)] |
|  |  |  | E = E0 + sL + [q(v) − q(0)] |
| Weights | 352 | 86 | 381 |

All: relative-MSE loss over (t_d, E); full-batch Adam, 60 000 epochs, learning rate 3e-3 → 3e-5 (cosine); best-validation weights; 5 seeds; RTX 5080, float32. KBNN: softplus on τ and s; L = ln(1 mV/|ΔV_in|), v = |ΔV_in|/0.3 V.

**Table 5. Cost of a metastability error rate**

| Route | Cost |
|---|---|
| Brute-force Spectre (10^12 comparisons) | ≈ 10^4 years |
| GPU Monte Carlo with a model, 10^9 conversions | 12 / 26 / 43 s (tanh / ReLU / KBNN) |
| Threshold sum with a model (1023 thresholds) | < 1 ms |
| KBNN closed form | ≈ 5 µs |
| Threshold sum with Spectre delays (85 simulations) | ≈ 40 s of Spectre per condition |
